page_title: HOF 1-1 MAI | Hoffenheim v Mainz 26/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Hoffenheim force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90+6' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
90+3' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Silvan Widmer leaves the pitch and Danny da Costa (Mainz) comes on.
90+3' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
90+1' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Marco Richter (Mainz) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
87' Marco Richter (Mainz) fires in the free kick from a promising position just outside the box. It's a fantastic strike and looks set for glory, but it only rattles the crossbar!
86' Poor challenge! Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) is penalised for tripping and Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle. Mainz earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
84' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

83' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Mainz will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
81' Marco Richter (Mainz) fires the ball from the free kick and it smashes against the crossbar!
80' Another situation results in a direct free kick for Mainz.
78' It will be a substitution. Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim) is ready to enter the pitch as Anton Stach walks off.
78' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
75' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
73' Jan Siewert decides to make a substitution. Jae-Sung Lee will be replaced by Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz).
73' What a sensational goal that would have been! Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) picks up the ball inside the box and fires a beautiful first-time shot, but it goes just a few inches wide of the right post.
69' It is time for a substitution. Brajan Gruda (Mainz) is on for Aymen Barkok.
68' Marco Richter (Mainz) commits a foul during an attacking move.
68' Marco Richter (Mainz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Deniz Aytekin had an easy-decision to make.
68' Aymen Barkok (Mainz) wastes a huge opportunity to score from the penalty spot. He attempts to slot into the bottom right corner, but Oliver Baumann pulls off a superb save.
68' Aymen Barkok (Mainz) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
67' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
66' There's a break in play and referee Deniz Aytekin must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Mainz using VAR. This could be interesting!
65' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
63' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Robert Skov.
63' Chance! Aymen Barkok (Mainz) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
62' Golden chance! Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post.

61' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the top right corner. Oliver Baumann is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
60' Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
58' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
58' The percentage of ball possession is – 63:37.
53' Marco Richter (Mainz) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.

48' 1 - 1 Goal! Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a brilliant pass and fires a first-time shot into the bottom right corner. Pavel Kaderabek assisted in the goal. 1:1.
46' Half-time substitution. Pellegrino Matarazzo decided to make a change. Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) is replaced by Pavel Kaderabek.
46' Half-time substitution. Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) is replaced by Florian Grillitsch.
46' The game is over for Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim). Kevin Akpoguma comes on for the second half.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) headed the rebound goalwards, but the ball hits the left post!
45+5' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
44' Deniz Aytekin shows a yellow card to Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) for his blatant foul.
44' Deniz Aytekin couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) and blew his whistle.
44' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Mainz.
43' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Aymen Barkok (Mainz) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
41' Aymen Barkok (Mainz) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Oliver Baumann pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.

39' 0 - 1 What a GOAL! A quick turnover allows Marco Richter (Mainz) to mount a one-man counter attack and ends with him scoring with a precise shot from close in that easily beats the keeper. That makes it 0:1.
38' The corner from Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) is intercepted by Oliver Baumann.
36' Marco Richter (Mainz) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
35' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) works the corner short.
32' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
32' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Deniz Aytekin blows for a foul.
30' John Anthony Brooks (Hoffenheim) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
30' John Anthony Brooks (Hoffenheim) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Anthony Caci (Mainz) has tested the patience of referee Deniz Aytekin and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
28' Anthony Caci (Mainz) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for a foul.
25' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
25' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
25' Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
25' Unsporting behaviour by Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz).
24' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
24' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) prepares to take a corner kick.
22' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but smashes his shot just inches past the left post. He should have scored!
21' The ball is cleared after Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
19' Tom Krauss (Mainz) is penalised for a foul. Deniz Aytekin had a clear view and blows his whistle.
19' Tom Krauss (Mainz) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
18' The ratio of the ball possession is 69:31.
16' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim).
14' Aymen Barkok (Mainz) commits a rough challenge and Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Hoffenheim are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
7' CLOSE! Marco Richter (Mainz) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the right post!
5' Tom Krauss (Mainz) drives in a shot at goal, but the attempt from the edge of the box flashes just over the bar.
3' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
1' Aymen Barkok (Mainz) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Mainz will kick-off.
